name: Commander Fleet Activities Chinhae
tagline: The Navy's base on Korea's southern coast near Busan, with a DoDEA school and a satellite clinic.
coords_source: approximate point on the installation, from public maps
_note: Written on 2026-11-21 by scripts/guides/write_missed_guides.py from the official pages named in each section. Not in the first installation list; added after the missed-bases check.

data.Location: Chinhae (Jinhae), on the southern coast of South Korea
data.School: Charles Turner Joy Elementary/Middle School, DoDEA

sections.title: Housing
data: Command-sponsored families start the housing process by email with the housing office; the directory says a house is usually assigned in about a week. Unaccompanied members are assigned housing on arrival.
To be command sponsored, family members need Dependent Entry Approval and must be on the official orders. Family members not on orders can enter only on a 90-day tourist visa.

sections.title: Housing allowance (OHA, not BAH)
data: South Korea is an overseas location for housing allowances. Service members who live off base receive the Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) instead of BAH. OHA is set by rank, dependents and the actual rent, up to a ceiling, with separate amounts for utilities and move-in costs.
Check your own figures with the official OHA calculator before you sign a lease.

source.label: Defense Travel Management Office, Overseas Housing Allowance

sections.title: Schools
data: DoDEA lists Charles Turner Joy Elementary/Middle School in Chinhae. Ask the school liaison about grades served and high school options.

sections.title: Medical care
data: The clinic at Chinhae is a satellite of U.S. Naval Hospital Yokosuka. It gives outpatient adult, pediatric and women's health care, with X-ray, some lab tests and a small pharmacy. Inpatient care is at accredited Korean hospitals. Routine pregnancies get prenatal care at the clinic, with delivery at a Korean hospital. Overseas screening is required for members and family members before the move.

source.label: Military OneSource, CFA Chinhae health care
